settings.microstrip_model: Hammerstad/Jensen finite-thickness + Kirschning/Jansen dispersion, Qucs width convention
settings.impedance_convention: real nominal lossless line-model impedance; no lossy-complex or folded-effective extraction

unit_checks: microstrip: scale invariance and material sensitivity passed
slotline: scale invariance and material sensitivity passed
caveats: Nominal standard-line impedances are not the effective folded/sandwiched coupled network impedances.
Old TXLINE agreement checks implementation consistency, not accuracy against real current-material structures.
Slotline metal thickness and complex loss are not modeled; sample matching is not an exact fixed-P intervention.
Model-error uncertainty is not a formal statistical confidence interval.
